name: JW Marriott San Francisco Union Square
insider_take: This luxury tower puts you at the epicenter of San Francisco's shopping and theater district, where cable cars clang past your doorstep and Union Square's energy pulses 24/7.
whats_special: The JW Marriott occupies floors 7-21 of a striking Art Deco building that was once home to the historic Hale Brothers Department Store. Its prime Union Square location means you're literally steps from the Powell Street cable car turnaround - one of the most photographed spots in the city. The hotel's elevated position offers stunning views of the Bay, Alcatraz, and the city's iconic hills.
pro_tip: Book a room on the north side for unobstructed views of the Bay and Alcatraz Island, especially magical at sunset when the fog rolls in through the Golden Gate.
dont_miss: The historic cable car ride from your doorstep to Fisherman's Wharf, and the fact that Union Square hosts over 30 art galleries and flagship stores within a 3-block radius. The hotel sits atop the Powell Street BART/Muni station, making it incredibly easy to explore neighborhoods like Chinatown (3 blocks away) and North Beach.
pros: Prime Union Square location with easy access to shopping, dining, and public transportation
Elegant luxury accommodations with modern amenities and city views
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness center
Multiple dining venues including upscale restaurant and cocktail lounge
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury downtown San Francisco hotels
Busy urban location with typical city noise levels
